# Advance Africa

> A comprehensive platform connecting Africans and international students with scholarships, volunteer opportunities, internships, and employment across the African continent.

Advance Africa serves as a central hub for educational and professional opportunities in Africa, featuring curated listings for scholarships from major foundations, volunteer placements in Kenya, Tanzania, and Ethiopia, and job opportunities across African sectors. The platform emphasizes community building and enabling young people to gain experience through gap year programs, medical electives, and international internships.

## Key Topics

- African scholarships
- Volunteer opportunities
- International internships
- Gap year programs
- Medical electives
- Kenya volunteering
- Tanzania volunteering
- Ethiopia volunteering
- NGO grants
- Employment in Africa
- Developing countries
- Medical volunteer placements
- Teaching volunteer programs
- Orphanage volunteer work
- 2026-2027 opportunities

## Scholarships & Grants

- [Scholarships and Grants](https://www.advance-africa.com/Scholarships-and-Grants.html): Comprehensive scholarships and grants for international and African students
- [Scholarships for Study in Africa](https://www.advance-africa.com/Scholarships-for-Study-in-Africa.html): Directory of African scholarships for undergraduate, masters, and PhD study programs
- [List of Scholarships for International Students](https://www.advance-africa.com/List-of-Scholarships-for-International-Students.html): Comprehensive list of international scholarships from major foundations
- [Grants for NGOs and Organisations](https://www.advance-africa.com/Grants-for-NGOs-and-Organisations.html): Directory of NGO grants and funding opportunities from foundations and agencies

## Volunteer Programs

- [Volunteer in Africa](https://www.advance-africa.com/Volunteer-in-Africa.html): Volunteer opportunities in African countries including Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda
- [Volunteer in Kenya](https://www.advance-africa.com/Volunteer-in-Kenya.html): Kenya-specific volunteer programs in orphanages, schools, hospitals, and Maasai projects
- [Volunteer in Tanzania](https://www.advance-africa.com/Volunteer-in-Tanzania.html): Tanzania volunteer placements in orphanages, schools, and hospitals
- [Volunteer in Ethiopia](https://www.advance-africa.com/Volunteer-in-Ethiopia.html): Ethiopia volunteer programs in healthcare, education, and community service
- [Platform2](https://www.advance-africa.com/Platform2.html): Platform2 fully-funded volunteer program for young adults in Kenya and Africa

## Internships & Medical Placements

- [International Internship Programs](https://www.advance-africa.com/internships.html): Paid internship and industrial attachment programs across multiple continents
- [Medical Electives](https://www.advance-africa.com/Medical-Electives.html): Medical, nursing, dental, and physiotherapy electives and placements in Africa

## Jobs & Employment

- [Jobs in Africa](https://www.advance-africa.com/Jobs-in-Africa.html): Job listings and employment opportunities across African countries and sectors
- [Jobs in Kenya](https://www.advance-africa.com/Jobs-in-Kenya.html): Kenya-specific job listings in accounting, NGO, banking, government, and IT sectors
